newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners sees 30 pct annual growth.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners sees 30 pct annual growth.

text.p: MedPartners/Mulikin Inc expects its business to grow at a minimum 30 percent annual rate in the coming years, Mark Wagar, president of the company's western operations, said.
He said MedPartners, which is the largest physician practice management company in the U.S., will grow through expanding existing operations, making acquisitions, and adopting cost sayings.

The company recently merged with Caremark, another managed care company, which Wagar said will be 12 to 13 percent accretive to earnings this year. He said the merger will be 10 percent accretive in 1997.
He said the MedPartners's same market growth rate last quarter, was 21 percent.
